items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: my reason for joining the band was that after Buddy Tate left Nat Towles', several other things happened

ctx.x: Section men, and they worked well together. They had a lot of good arrangements. That was about the size of that band. The fact of the matter is it really wasn't built around solo players like the great jazz groups in the world, but however my reason for joining the band was that after Buddy Tate left Nat Towles', several other things happened that sort of took the interest out of the band, you know, because jazz music is music that is played inspiringly, and sometimes the musicians in the group make the band…
